headline: Management maintains consistent confidence in operational metrics like opex improvement and customer acquisition while achieving strong AUM and profit growth.

promises.promise: AUM growth of 20% to 24% in FY27
promises.quote: In terms of AUM, we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years as they begin to scale.
promises.evidence: Horizon FY27 ends in March 2027, so it remains pending as the latest reported data is for September 2026.

promises.promise: Add 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27
promises.quote: In terms of customer franchise, we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.
promises.evidence: Horizon FY27 ends in March 2027; full-year customer addition outcome is not yet reported by September 2026.

promises.promise: Improvement of 25 to 40 bps in opex to NTI
promises.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.
promises.evidence: Horizon is FY27; reported opex to NTI was 33.4% in Q1 FY27 and 33% in Q2 FY27, awaiting full year.

promises.quote: We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.
promises.evidence: ROA came in at 4.7% in Q1 FY27 and 4.6% in Q2 FY27, awaiting full year FY27 completion.

promises.quote: Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.
promises.evidence: ROE was 20.4% in Q1 FY27 and 20.6% in Q2 FY27, awaiting full year FY27 completion.

promises.promise: Deploy over 600 autonomous agents in FY27
promises.quote: In FY27, we expect to deploy 600-plus autonomous agents and across operations, DMS, HR, technology and risk.

promises.promise: Disburse INR11,000 crores to INR12,000 crores via AI bots
promises.quote: On disbursements, AI, voice and text bots did INR2,500 crores, we will do INR11,000 crores INR12,000 in the full year this year.
promises.evidence: Horizon is full year FY27, pending final results.

promises.promise: Deliver 60 to 62 million new loans in FY27
promises.quote: We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.

shifts.change: Target range for new customer additions was revised upwards from 15-17 million in Q4 FY26 to 18-20 million in Q2 FY27.
Longer-term AUM growth guidance was specified as 23% to 25% in Q2 FY27 compared to medium-term 20% to 25% previously.
